interview.name: Rey
interview.answer: It meets at the community center parking lot, but the exact time isn’t in the notes.

reflections: Rey is the main organizer of the repair drive and responds calmly to confusion by helping people clarify needs.
Oren seems uncertain and forgetful, and benefits from direct, patient guidance.
Ira is supportive and proactive, offering practical help once they understand what is still needed.
Rey is coordinating a repair effort and others are responding with practical help.
Ira offers opportunistic support while running errands, suggesting a casual but helpful relationship.
Rosa and Eli both respond reliably with promised follow-up lists, indicating they trust Rey to organize the effort.
Rey is acting as the organizer and point person, repeatedly asking others for needed details and keeping track of outstanding repairs.
Eli and Faye respond as supportive contributors who want clear guidance and timing before they can help effectively.
The group seems to work best with concise status updates and a shared list, since missed changes and incomplete information are causing coordination friction.
Rey is the main organizer, repeatedly coordinating repair-drive details and following up on timing and supplies.
The others are mostly trying to stay informed and offer help, but they often lack the latest confirmed details.
Hana appears to be the most up-to-date on the repair list and exact time, acting as a reliable source for Rey.
Hana is the central coordinator, repeatedly restating logistics so others stay aligned.
Rey acts as the main relay point for spreading information and confirming attendance details.
The group is collaborative and task-focused, with members offering help once they have the repair list, timing, and location.

events.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive—what part do you need help with?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: I keep mixing up the details, sorry—could you help me sort out what still needs fixing?
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Of course — let’s go through it together and make a quick list of what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Ira: Oh, I’ve been meaning to ask—how’s the repair drive going?
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Rey: It’s going steadily—people have been dropping off a few things. I’m still gathering what we need, though.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Ira: That’s good to hear. If you’re still short on anything, I can keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start with the most urgent repairs and send you the list plus timeline as soon as I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — that’d be really helpful. Send it over when you can, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we still need.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rosa: Of course — I’m on it and I’ll send the urgent repairs list plus timeline soon.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — I’ll put together a short list and send it over soon.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — that would help a lot. Send it when you can, and I’ll keep track of what’s still needed.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Eli: Will do, Rey. I’ll send the list over soon so you can keep it organized.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: I’m still sorting the repair drive out—what part do you need help with?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: Just the repair drive details and timing would help — I can work it around the school run once I have that.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’m putting together the details and timing now, and I’ll send you a quick list soon.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Of course — let’s go through what still needs fixing and make a quick list together.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Noah: Oh, right — that sounds good. I might’ve missed a change, so just point me to what still needs fixing and I’ll help if I can.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Rey: Sure — let’s start with the urgent repairs and then we can work through the rest together.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: I’m still only hearing bits and pieces—do you have the latest on the repair drive, like the time or what they still need?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: I’m still sorting the repair drive out—what part do you need help with?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: I’m just trying to catch the latest on the time and what supplies they still need. If you’ve got anything confirmed, I’m happy to help spread the word.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll send the repair list and the time again so we’re both set.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — that’d help a lot. I’m still sorting the repair drive out, so send me the list and timing when you can.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll resend the repair list and exact time shortly so you’ve got everything lined up.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Oren: Right, sorry — I’m a bit scattered today. If you send me the repair list and time again, I’ll bring what’s needed.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll send the repair list and time over again. Thanks, Oren.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep an eye out for it and be there with the tools.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — please spread the word that the repair drive meets at the community center parking lot.
events.speaker: Opal

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Rey: Will do — what time should I tell everyone to be there?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — please tell everyone to arrive at 10 AM.
events.speaker: Opal
